workarounds.note: every symbol is imported from esm.sh/postext?bundle and initMathEngine() is awaited before the build

no math.fontSizeScale: 1.4.1 gives a formula an x-height of half the type size, about 13 % above MathJax's own 0.442 em, which happens to match Inria Serif's 0.495 em; set math.fontSizeScale near 1.12 (0.495 / 0.442) once the scale is fixed
~sub~ drops its figure a third of an em, as far as ^sup^ rises: the 15 pt leading on 10.5 pt keeps every dropped subscript clear of the next line
a display formula does not keep with its lead-in: the copy of both editions is fitted so the [OH−] equation ends page 1 under the sentence that introduces it
justified text may end a page on a hyphen: after each copy-fit, page 3 of both editions was checked to end on a whole word
a no-break space still breaks, so the text uses none: units are written mol·dm^−3^ (one word), and every number–unit pair was checked to sit mid-line in both editions
the inline table gets no space below it: ::resource is followed by :::space{lines=1}

ragged text breaks between adjacent runs with no space between them: the Flowers reference keeps its comma after *Chemistry 2e* mid-line in both editions, and the Table 1 caption is cut to one line, because at two lines the English one broke between 'mol·dm' and its superscript '−3'
col() writes the hex as well as the palette id, since design slots read only the hex

the report style sets span: 'page' in this one-column report only so the band and the burette paint from the top of the page: a heading design kept in the column is clipped at the column's top edge, 24 mm down, and those 24 mm print white
the mean and standard-deviation labels span three columns through mergeCells, which writes the hiddenBy placeholders a merge needs
not routed around: the canvas pages show pale hairlines between the slate header cells of Table 1; the PDF is clean
resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG), since the locale leaves Figure and Table in English
the hyphenation locale is an exact code: 'es' or 'en-us'
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it

bodyText.maxRuntTracking: 0 is a guard: no paragraph of either edition triggers a runt fix today (removing it leaves both layouts unchanged), and a runt fix's negative tracking is measured but not painted
